dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL; uses COPY includes with .INC extension and MCP (middleware) database calls typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt) processing system — comprehensive medical act (包括診療行為) check processing for inpatient/outpatient billing
purpose.summary: This subprogram performs validation checks on bundled/comprehensive medical treatment acts (包括診療行為チェック) within the JMA ORCA standard receipt software. It checks whether medical procedures qualify for bundled billing, handles inpatient fee calculation period checks, and manages automatic generation checks. It is called with a parameter area specifying the type of processing (full check, auto-generation, error deletion, inpatient fee check, etc.).

notable_features: 19 COPY statements for shared record layouts (.INC files)
MCP middleware database access pattern (MCP-TABLE, MCP-RC, PERFORM 910-DBSELECT-SEC)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple parameter areas (USING clause)
OCCURS tables for medical procedure codes and bundling classification
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses ORCA MCP abstraction layer
EVALUATE for dispatch on processing type code
Large working-storage with complex nested OCCURS structures
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 120223 bytes (2734 lines total); full procedure division not visible but structure is clear from what is shown.
